min_input: spec §13: parse("Sun, 06 Nov 1994 08:49:60 GMT") -> datetime(1994, 11, 6, 8, 49, 60, tzinfo=utc)
stack:
# stdlib datetime.__init__ rejects second=60 outright
python -c "from datetime import datetime, timezone; datetime(1994, 11, 6, 8, 49, 60, tzinfo=timezone.utc)"
# -> ValueError: second must be in 0..59
description: spec.md §13 promises parse(':60') -> datetime(..., 8, 49, 60, ...), which stdlib datetime (both __init__ and C __new__) rejects. The implementation chose the correct workaround (_LeapSecondDatetime wrapping the next-minute instant). INFO; spec needs an edit to match reality.
source: T01 manual audit; live-verified at HEAD 14295be
